title: Automated tenant bootstrap and policy-bundle generator for Private deployments
author: Maya Patel
description: Introduce an automated policy-bundle generator and idempotent tenant bootstrap flow for Private deployments to simplify initial operator setup and tenant onboarding. Motivation: customers deploying Redwood Private currently perform manual RBAC wiring across cluster namespaces, service accounts, and cloud IAM + KMS roles; this is error-prone and causes onboarding delays during enterprise installs. This PR implements a deterministic policy bundle generator (Go tool), Helm chart templates for operator bootstrap, Terraform module updates to wire cloud IAM roles for KMS/HSM access, preflight checks to validate cluster RBAC and network reachability, and migration utilities to convert existing manual role mappings into managed bundles. High-level changes: 1) new tool private/installer/tools/policygen (Go) that outputs bundled YAML per-tenant with namespaced rolebindings, aggregated ClusterRoles for operator actions, and optional KMS IAM mapping annotations; 2) Helm templates under charts/private/templates/rbac-bootstrap.yaml implementing a two-phase bootstrap: operator-serviceaccount creation + cluster-level bootstrap job (runs once); 3) terraform/modules/private-rbac adds optional cloud_role_arn input and automates iam_policy attachment for KMS; 4) hack/preflight-rbac-check.sh validates required APIs, existing conflicting bindings, and idempotency; 5) docs/private/rbac-automation.md with recommended upgrade path and rollback steps. Backwards compatibility: generator recognizes legacy mappings (label selector and annotation based) and will emit a migration report; default behavior is non-destructive (does not delete existing bindings). Rollout plan: merge to main behind feature flag PRIVATE_RBAC_AUTOMATION=false, ship as opt-in in next Private release, and follow with an enablement blog + migration tool runbook. Testing: unit tests for generator, integration tests in perf-canary infra that exercise bootstrap job lifecycle, manual validation with on-prem test cluster. Related: referenced ENG-4821 for tracking rollout milestones and PM-205 for documentation and support tasks. Checklist: [x] generator + tests; [x] helm templates; [x] terraform wiring; [x] preflight checks; [x] docs + runbook; [x] migration utility and report. Merge note: squash merge after approvals.

review_comments: Owen Li: Nice. Please ensure the generator emits stable names (hash+prefix) to avoid churn during re-apply. Also add unit tests for name stability.
Maya Patel: Added stable name algorithm (tenant prefix + truncated sha256) and unit tests in commit 3/5.
Sofia Ruiz: CI showed a failing integration test on the first run related to the bootstrap job imagePullPolicy; suggest forcing IfNotPresent to avoid flakes.
Maya Patel: Switched job template to imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent and re-ran integration tests. All green now.
Anand Kapoor: Terraform changes look mostly fine, but please add a guard so cloud_role_arn is optional and we fall back to local KMS annotations for air-gapped installs.
Maya Patel: Implemented guard and added documentation for air-gapped mode in docs/private/rbac-automation.md.
release_notes: Automated RBAC policy bundle generator and tenant bootstrap for Private installer. Adds opt-in automation for creating operator service accounts, cluster-level bootstrap jobs, Terraform wiring for KMS IAM roles, and migration tooling for legacy bindings. Non-destructive by default.
